svg.title: Gantry: ship design proposal
svg.desc: Plan, side, forward, and three-quarter views from one unscaled model. Structural forms and colors are proposals, not approved physical specifications.
svg.text: DESIGN PROPOSAL / NOT AN ENGINEERING DRAWING
Broad plated cargo body / raised handling frame

NO PHYSICAL SCALE OR DIMENSIONS APPROVED
